title: What clients say about working with us
text: Reviews from developers, municipalities, body corporates and private clients across the firm's areas of practice.
source: Collected from Google reviews and written client feedback.

items.name: Nadia Pillay
items.quote: They told us at the outset which approvals would be slow and why, and the programme they gave us held. When the objection came in, the response was ready the same week.

items.name: Thabo Ngcobo
items.quote: We briefed HSG on a tenure upgrade affecting more than four hundred households. They worked through the register household by household and explained the process in language the community could follow.

items.name: Sarah-Jane Wilkinson
items.quote: Our transfer was not straightforward — there was an old servitude nobody had picked up. It was explained plainly, the cost of sorting it out was set out before any work started, and we registered a month later.

items.name: Dr Anwar Ebrahim
items.quote: A long-running dispute with a contractor that two other firms had not resolved. HSG were candid that mediation was the better route than litigation, and it settled. Not the answer we wanted at first, but it was the right one.

items.name: Lerato Mokoena
items.quote: Three separate acquisitions inside eighteen months. The same two people handled all of them, so nothing had to be explained twice, and the reporting was consistent throughout.

items.name: Gerhard van Niekerk
items.quote: We needed an honest view on whether an authorisation would survive a challenge. We were told where we were exposed rather than what we hoped to hear, and we fixed it before it became a problem.
